panel.default_message:
Need help?
Open a ticket here and our team will assist you.

claim.reply_desc: You are now handling this ticket.

close.channel_desc:
Closed by <@{user}>.
A team member can reopen it or delete it permanently.

delete.channel_desc: This channel will be removed in 5 seconds…
delete.reply_desc: The channel will be removed shortly.

member.added_desc: <@{target}> was added to the ticket by <@{actor}>.
member.removed_desc: <@{target}> was removed from the ticket by <@{actor}>.

replies.perm_reopen: Only the support team can reopen tickets.
replies.perm_delete: Only the support team can delete tickets.
replies.perm_unclaim_full: Only the support team (or whoever claimed the ticket) can release it.

delete_confirm.prompt_desc: This removes the channel **permanently**. The ticket log is kept.
delete_confirm.cancelled_desc: The ticket will not be deleted.
delete_confirm.deleting_desc: The channel is being removed now…

errors.not_a_ticket: No ticket found for this channel.
errors.module_disabled: The ticket module is currently disabled.
errors.category_gone: This ticket category no longer exists.
errors.no_discord_category: No Discord category has been set for this category (neither on the category nor as a default).
errors.discord_category_gone: The configured Discord category no longer exists.
errors.bot_missing_manage_channels: The bot is missing the "Manage Channels" permission.
errors.max_open: You already have {open} open ticket(s). Maximum: {max}.
errors.opener_not_removable: The opener cannot be removed from their own ticket.
errors.rename_invalid: Please provide a valid name (a–z, 0–9, - and _).
errors.perm_claim: Only the support team can claim tickets.
errors.perm_close_restricted: Only team members can close tickets.
errors.perm_close: Only the support team or the opener can close the ticket.
errors.perm_support_only: Only the support team can do that.
errors.perm_unclaim: Only whoever claimed the ticket or the support team can release it.

modmail.received_desc: Your message reached the support team. Just keep replying here – I'll forward everything until the case is closed.
modmail.unavailable_desc: Bot support is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
modmail.header_desc:
This channel is linked to this person's **direct messages**. Everything the team writes here is sent to them as a DM.
Internal note? Start the message with `{prefix}` – it will **not** be forwarded.
modmail.err_no_channel: Bot support is not fully set up yet (no category configured).
modmail.err_bot_perms: The bot is missing the "Manage Channels" permission on the support server.
modmail.err_generic: Something went wrong while creating the ticket.
modmail.closed_desc: Your case has been closed. Just message me again if you need more help.
modmail.reopen_desc: Your case is open again – you can keep writing here.
modmail.deleted_desc: Your case has been finished. You can always message me again if needed.
